name: Salesforce
one_liner: Enterprise cloud CRM for sales, service, and custom business apps.
notes: Free Developer Edition exists; Connected Apps use OAuth 2.0. REST plus GraphQL. MCP exists in community/DX experiments, not a long-standing official product MCP.

name: Zendesk
one_liner: Customer support suite with tickets, help center, and messaging.
notes: OAuth 2.0 and API tokens. Trial/developer accounts are self-serve; some plans gate advanced APIs.

name: Slack
one_liner: Workplace messaging platform with channels, apps, and workflows.
notes: Slack apps use OAuth 2.0. Web API is broad REST. Slack publishes an official MCP server.

name: Google Ads
one_liner: Google's paid search, display, and video advertising platform.
blocker: API use requires a Google Ads developer token, which Google must approve.
notes: OAuth 2.0 plus a developer token. Token approval is the main gate, not a missing API.

name: Shopify
one_liner: Hosted ecommerce platform for online stores and checkout.
notes: OAuth for public apps; Admin API tokens for custom apps. REST and GraphQL. Shopify documents MCP/dev tools.

name: DataForSEO
one_liner: Pay-as-you-go SEO, SERP, and keyword data API.
blocker: Paid credits required after signup; not partnership-gated.
notes: HTTP Basic (login/password) to a self-serve REST API. Signup is open; usage is paid.

name: GitHub
one_liner: Git hosting, PRs, issues, and CI for software teams.
notes: OAuth apps, GitHub Apps, and PATs. REST plus GraphQL. Official GitHub MCP server.

name: Notion
one_liner: Docs, wikis, and databases for team knowledge and tasks.
notes: Internal integrations use a bearer token; public integrations use OAuth. Official Notion MCP exists.

name: Stripe
one_liner: Payments, billing, and financial infrastructure APIs.
notes: Secret/publishable API keys for the account; OAuth for Stripe Connect platforms. Official Stripe MCP.

name: NotebookLM
one_liner: Google research notebook that grounds answers in uploaded sources.
blocker: No public self-serve NotebookLM API; enterprise Gemini/Workspace paths are gated.
notes: Consumer product is UI-only. Do not treat Gemini API as NotebookLM. Human should confirm if an Enterprise API appeared.
